services.name: View Charters
services.desc: Experience the pinnacle of Italian yacht craftsmanship with the VERADA, a meticulously maintained Uniesse 42' open motor yacht based in Naples, Florida. This stunning 45-foot luxury vessel combines elegant design, powerful twin Cummins engines, and premium amenities to deliver unforgettable charter experiences on Southwest Florida's pristine Gulf Coast waters. Available exclusively for professional captain-led charters, the VERADA accommodates up to 6 guests in climate-controlled comfort with spacious indoor and outdoor areas, perfect for Naples sunset cruises, Keewaydin Island adventures, and custom Gulf Coast explorations.
